page.hero: Non-invasive ultrasonic energy and flow meter. The device clips onto an existing pipe without interrupting the circuit, and reports its readings to a real-time web supervision app.
page.section2Text: The web app serves as an IoT fleet management platform. It centralizes and monitors every deployed meter: streaming real-time readings, sending commands to devices (firmware updates, reconfiguration), and viewing device information — connection status, version, identifiers, event history.

page.hero: Sensor measuring soil microbiological activity. Deployed directly in the field, the measuring bell automatically records three key indicators every four hours — CO₂ concentration, temperature and soil moisture — helping farmers adapt their practices and optimize yields.
page.heroCaption: Measuring bell deployed in the field
page.section2Text: The web app centralizes management of the deployed sensor fleet. It lets you view readings from each device in real time, access historical data across multiple seasons, receive alerts on notable events, and consult regular reports on soil vitality indicators. Commands can be sent to sensors to update or reconfigure them remotely.

page.hero: Universal motor control solution. The Smartdriver acts as a protocol translator — it converts incoming commands into the specific language required by each motor or actuator, allowing obsolete equipment to be replaced without changing the existing installation. With up to 6 driver modules per unit, it targets industrial robotics, CNC machines, lab automation and scientific instrumentation.
page.heroCaption: Smartdriver unit — up to 6 driver modules
page.section2Text: Desktop app built with Electron for configuring and tuning Smartdriver modules over a USB connection. It offers an intuitive interface to set up motors, send direct commands via a serial terminal, perform firmware updates and monitor axis status in real time.

oneair-world.hintDesktop: Press Enter to view the OneairWorld project
oneair-world.hintMobile: Tap the 💬 icon to view the OneairWorld project

page.hero: You're exploring the result right now. OneairWorld is an interactive multiplayer resume — a persistent world where every visitor moves in real time alongside others. Players' positions, actions and states are synchronized over WebSocket every frame.
page.subCaption: Project started 4 years ago — several cycles of testing and technology research.
page.videoCaption: Each player's data — position, direction, state — is sent to the server on every input and broadcast to all clients connected to the same Colyseus room. Physics (Matter.js) runs exclusively server-side: the client sends inputs, the server responds with the authoritative state.

stack.colyseus: Backend multiplayer framework — room management and real-time state synchronization
stack.matter: Server-side physics engine — collisions, velocities, rigid bodies
stack.phaser: Frontend game engine — scene rendering, animations, inputs
stack.react: User interface — overlays, dialogues, out-of-game screens
stack.docker: Containerization and deployment of the Colyseus server
